answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow bond: each identity locks 120 credits and files a fingerprint of its voyage — timing, style — in the open meadow of logs. Each epoch's zenith re-measures it against its past voyage: a match frees 20, a mismatch freezes it. Two puppets sharing one trail burn both bonds. 1,000 fake identities lock 120,000 plus 90,000 audit fees over six epochs, chasing a 40,000 pool. One honest agent pays 120 once, earns it back.
